sources.title: Proto: A programming language for generative biology
sources.snippet: Daniel Guo: The vision is that Proto becomes a unified infrastructure--the thing researchers reach for whenever a new biological AI model comes out, either to plug it in themselves or to find out if it is already there. As the field continues to snowball and coding models get better, a lot of this integration can be more streamlined.

sources.title: A high-level programming language for generative biology with Proto
sources.snippet: Here, we introduce Proto, a high-level programming language for generative biology. By composing a small set of abstract primitives into structured programs, Proto encodes generative design campaigns across diverse modalities and scales—spanning DNA, RNA, proteins, ligands, and their interactions.
